name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Per Bolivia's own Foreign Ministry consular portal, the Student Visa permits foreign nationals to study at primary, secondary, or higher-education institutions in Bolivia, valid up to 60 days and renewable annually until studies conclude. A consular embassy source (not itself hosted on a .gob.bo domain, so treated as corroborating rather than primary) adds that applications require a letter of acceptance from the institution, a copy of any interinstitutional agreement, and a financial-solvency certificate from the sending institution or sponsor; minors need parental travel authorization.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain an acceptance letter from a Bolivian educational institution and a financial-solvency certificate, then apply at a Bolivian consulate.

outcome.duration_length: up to 60 days per issuance, renewable annually until studies conclude

sources.title: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia -- official Student Visa definition, validity, renewal terms

Embassy of Bolivia (Belgium consular section) -- application documents (acceptance letter, financial-solvency certificate), fees, timeline; site is embassy-run but not on a .gob.bo domain, treated as tier 3 rather than tier 1

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bolivia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- the hard requirement's core citation is a genuine tier-1 source (Bolivia's own Foreign Ministry consular portal), reached and read directly rather than via a secondary summary. The 60-days-renewable-annually validity structure is unusual (short relative to a full academic term) -- this dataset presents it as the plain reading of the primary source rather than assuming it means something else; it may reflect a short initial entry permit that gets locally extended rather than the total study period, but that inference was not confirmed and is not asserted as fact.
